properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 23 at 5:14AM EDT until August 23 at 7:15AM EDT by NWS Tallahassee FL
properties.description:
SMWTAE

The National Weather Service in Tallahassee has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from  Suwannee River to Keaton Beach out 20 NM...
Waters from Suwannee River to Apalachicola FL from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 715 AM EDT.

* At 512 AM EDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from near Buckeye Reef to 25 nm southwest of Suwannee
River, moving southwest at 10 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots...suddenly higher
waves...frequent lightning...and heavy downpours. Make
sure all on board are wearing life jackets.

* Locations impacted include...
V Tower and Buckeye Reef.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor immediately as gusty winds and high waves are
expected.

Frequent lightning is occurring with these storms. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 23 at 5:07AM EDT until August 23 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Mount Holly NJ
properties.description:
At 507 AM EDT, Thunderstorms that produced heavy rain resulted in 1
to 2 inches of rain. While the rain has ended, flash flooding is
ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets, and underpasses as well as other
drainage and low lying areas.

Some locations that may experience flash flooding include...
Philadelphia, Camden, Bensalem, Yeadon, Palmyra, Hatboro,
Jenkintown, Narberth, National Park, East Lansdowne, Beverly and
Rockledge.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 476 in Pennsylvania between mile markers 8 and 12.
Interstate 76 in Pennsylvania between mile markers 333 and 351.
Interstate 95 in Pennsylvania between mile markers 15 and 37.
Interstate 676 in Pennsylvania between mile markers 0 and 1.
Pennsylvania Turnpike between mile markers 337 and 347.
properties.instruction:
Turn around...don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most
flood deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 23 at 4:56AM EDT until August 23 at 7:45AM EDT by NWS Mount Holly NJ
properties.description:
At 456 AM EDT, Thunderstorms produced heavy rain in the warned area,
with flash flooding reported in Chester. Between 1 and 2 inches of
rain have fallen. While the heavy rain has ended, flash flooding is
occurring.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets, and underpasses as well as other
drainage and low lying areas.

Some locations that may experience flash flooding include...
Philadelphia, Wilmington, Chester, Yeadon, Carneys Point,
Folcroft, Swarthmore, Penns Grove, Arden, Chester Township,
Chelsea and Nether Providence Township.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 476 in Pennsylvania between mile markers 0 and 7.
Interstate 95 in Pennsylvania between mile markers 0 and 9.
Interstate 95 in Delaware between mile markers 15 and 23.
properties.instruction:
Turn around...don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most
flood deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.
